text_block_list.text:
Clashing with Bamboo Memory got me so 
hyped! Races with rivals are the absolute 
best! In that case, racing against my 
crush would be straight-up crazy, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios instantly wants to race 
Daiichi Ruby... but the distance makes it 
look pretty tough. Sad vibes, but hanging 
out normally works just fine too.
